DesignPage.description: Basic details about a page in a design, such as the page number and thumbnail.

id.description:
The ID of the page. This ID is unique within the design and can be used to
correlate a page with per-page data from other APIs.

Some designs might not have page IDs, in which case this property is omitted.

index.description:
WARNING: This property is deprecated. Use `page_number` instead, which returns an identical value.

The index of the page in the design. The first page in a design has the index value `1`.

page_number.description: The 1-based page number within the design. The first page in a design has the value `1`.

DesignTypeOutputName.description: The type of content a design or page contains. The list of design types may grow over time. The `unknown` value represents design types that haven't been added to the list.

PageDimensions.description: The dimensions of a design page, if it is bounded. Design pages for non-bounded designs like Whiteboards and Docs will not include this property.

width.description: The width of the design page in pixels.

height.description: The height of the design page in pixels.

Thumbnail.description: A thumbnail image representing the object.

width.description: The width of the thumbnail image in pixels.

height.description: The height of the thumbnail image in pixels.

url.description:
A URL for retrieving the thumbnail image.
This URL expires after 15 minutes. This URL includes a query string
that's required for retrieving the thumbnail.
